local function DMVTL_fake_script() -- ImageButton.LocalScript 
	local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', ImageButton)

	local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
	
	local image = script.Parent
	
	-- Save original values
	local originalPos = image.Position
	local originalSize = image.Size
	
	-- Start off-screen
	image.Position = UDim2.new(-1, 0, originalPos.Y.Scale, originalPos.Y.Offset)
	
	-- Tween info
	local flyInfo = TweenInfo.new(1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	local pulseInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
	
	-- Center position
	local centerPos = UDim2.new(
		0.5, -image.AbsoluteSize.X / 2,
		0.5, -image.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2
	)
	
	-- Slightly bigger size for pulse
	local pulseSize = UDim2.new(
		originalSize.X.Scale * 1.3,
		originalSize.X.Offset * 1.3,
		originalSize.Y.Scale * 1.3,
		originalSize.Y.Offset * 1.3
	)
	
	-- Fly tweens
	local flyIn = TweenService:Create(image, flyInfo, { Position = centerPos })
	local flyOut = TweenService:Create(image, flyInfo, { Position = originalPos })
	
	-- Pulse tweens
	local zoomIn = TweenService:Create(image, pulseInfo, { Size = pulseSize })
	local zoomOut = TweenService:Create(image, pulseInfo, { Size = originalSize })
	
	-- Play fly in
	flyIn:Play()
	flyIn.Completed:Wait()
	
	-- Pulse for 3 seconds
	local startTime = tick()
	while tick() - startTime < 3 do
		zoomIn:Play()
		zoomIn.Completed:Wait()
	
		zoomOut:Play()
		zoomOut.Completed:Wait()
	end
	
	-- Fly back
	flyOut:Play()
	
end
coroutine.wrap(DMVTL_fake_script)()
local function RKHLIQ_fake_script() -- Frame.LocalScript 
	local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', Frame)

	local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	
	local gui = script.Parent
	
	-- If the script is in a ScreenGui, grab the first Frame
	if gui:IsA("ScreenGui") then
		gui = gui:FindFirstChildOfClass("Frame")
	end
	
	if not gui then
		warn("No Frame found to drag")
		return
	end
	
	local dragging = false
	local dragStart
	local startPos
	
	local function update(input)
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		gui.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPos.X.Scale,
			startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale,
			startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)
	end
	
	gui.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = gui.Position
	
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragging = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
	
	UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
			update(input)
		end
	end)
	
end

		function SoulSteal(pos)
			local soulst = coroutine.wrap(function()
				local soul = Instance.new("Part",chara)
				soul.Size = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
				soul.CanCollide = false
				soul.Anchored = false
				soul.Position = pos

				soul.Transparency = 1
				local ptc = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter",soul)
				ptc.Texture = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=413366101"
				ptc.Size = NumberSequence.new(.5)
				ptc.LockedToPart = true
				ptc.Speed = NumberRange.new(0)
				ptc.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(9999)
				local bodpos = Instance.new("BodyPosition",soul)
				bodpos.Position = pos
				wait(2)
				soul.Touched:connect(function(hit)
					if hit.Parent == chara then
						soul:Destroy()
					end
				end)
				while soul do
					wait(.1)
					bodpos.Position = chara.Torso.Position
				end
			end)
			soulst()
		end

		function KillMortal(hitdude)
			local torsy = nil
			if hitdude:FindFirstChild("Torso")~=nil then
				torsy = hitdude.Torso	
			elseif hitdude:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")~=nil then
				torsy = hitdude.UpperTorso
			end
			local val = Instance.new("ObjectValue",hitdude)
			val.Name = "HasBeenHit"
			hitdude:BreakJoints()
			hitdude.Humanoid:Destroy()
			SoulSteal(torsy.Position)
			local chi = hitdude:GetChildren()
			for i = 1, #chi do
				if chi[i].ClassName == "Part" or chi[i].ClassName == "MeshPart" then
					local bodpos = Instance.new("BodyPosition",chi[i])
					bodpos.Position = chi[i].Position + Vector3.new(math.random(-5,5),math.random(-5,5),math.random(-5,5))
					ScatterEff(chi[i])
					chi[i].BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Really black")
				end
			end
			for i = 1, 4 do
				for i = 1, #chi do
					if chi[i].ClassName == "Part" or chi[i].ClassName == "MeshPart" then
						chi[i].Transparency = chi[i].Transparency + .25
						wait(.01)
					end
				end
			end
			for i = 1, #chi do
				if chi[i].ClassName == "Part" or chi[i].ClassName == "MeshPart" then
					chi[i]:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end
